title: Outline map of the USA
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 83 (Outline map of the USA (pupil PDF, printable))
intro: Lesson 83: Road Trip USA: landmarks on the map (VIPERS). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: Teacher-written information text for TGA
paras: The Grand Canyon in Arizona was carved by the Colorado River over millions of years. It is more than a mile deep in places.
The Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco opened in 1937. Its famous orange-red colour helps ships see it in the fog.
The Statue of Liberty stands in New York Harbor. It was a gift from France and was finished in 1886.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The Colorado River carved the Grand Canyon.

keywords.def: a famous building or natural feature that helps people know a place
a deep valley with steep sides, carved by a river
one of the 50 parts of the USA, each with its own government
where the land meets the sea
